acceptanceCriteria: Fixture tests produce each oracle_origin value.
A CHANGED_IN_DIFF outcome caps the verdict at INCONCLUSIVE with reason oracle-self-certified until accepted.
The shadow report counts scenarios by origin.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. A change can edit both the code and the declared outcome it is checked against, so the scenario certifies itself. Per CCE-V0-016 each compiled scenario records its outcome's origin by joining the declarations at base and head; CHANGED_IN_DIFF and NEW_IN_DIFF outcomes cannot yield DISCRIMINATES or PRESERVES without a human acceptance, and the shadow gate excludes them.
